item.title: When Neutron Stars Collide: Listening for the Heart of Matter
item.description: Gravitational waves from merging neutron stars reveal hidden phase transitions inside their ultra-dense cores.

item.title: Eavesdropping on Water’s Heavy Twin in a Distant Disk
item.description: For the first time, semi-heavy water ice is detected in a planet-forming disk, revealing a crucial chapter in water's cosmic journey.

item.title: A White Dwarf's Final Breath: Forging the Heaviest Elements
item.description: A magnetized white dwarf collapses into a neutron star, ejecting neutron-rich material that forges heavy elements like gold and uranium in a kilonova-like event.

item.title: When the Universe’s Symmetry Splinters: A Quantum Gravity Path to Dark Energy
item.description: Perfect symmetry splinters into fragments of Hilbert space, leaving an accelerating cosmos as a residual quantum echo.

item.title: When Gravity's Subregions Insist on Purity
item.description: A frozen spacetime region in the gravitational path integral yields a pure quantum state, challenging the assumption that subregions must be mixed.

item.title: When Entropy Dares to Be Negative
item.description: Negative entropy in two-sided black hole calculations is rescued by non-perturbative instanton saddles, restoring positivity and consistency with quantum mechanics.
